approach: Edit three docs only. In records-history.md: rename the ref to branch `athena/records` (own root) everywhere (status, §3 table A4 row, recommendation and assumption, §6.1, §7 table, §10 job 1, §12), add a "why a branch" paragraph and a host-rules requirement replacing the refs/athena/* assumption, add §5.1 pre-merge up-to-date requirement with the failure case, add a new readers section with a table of code paths read and after-cutover reads, assign the reader work to build job 7 (cutover) by expanding it, or splitting a new job, and fill the three open points. In decisions.md accept D112 citing the addenda. Add a CHANGELOG entry and supersede the 'Awaiting Sri's decision' line. No code changes.

decisions.choice: The readers section uses a worktree of athena/records at a fixed path (state directory, e.g. <state>/records-worktree), and each reader gets a row: reads now, reads after, owning job.
decisions.reason: Most readers go through one of two seams, so the table can group by seam: (a) `Records::load(git, treeish)` in crates/athena-core/src/store.rs line 239 and `RecordSet::load` in athena-gate, which read the git tree at HEAD; after the cutover they take the records branch tip as the treeish. (b) `read_records(root: &Path)` in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs line 316 and `backtest::read_records`, which read the filesystem under root/records; after the cutover root is the worktree path.

rejected.why: The brief wants each named reader with a code path.

rejected.option: Have every reader shell out to git show on the branch
rejected.why: Slower and duplicates the two existing seams.

decisions.choice: Report in the readers section the facts found in code, including that the study site generator (xtask/src/site.rs) reads STUDY_DIR = studies/firstmate-work-handling, not records/, so it needs no move; and that xtask/src/walltime.rs reads records/jobs from a directory and is also a reader to move.
decisions.reason: Evidence rule and strangers rule: the brief's list is the floor, and the code shows the site generator does not read records/. Saying so is more accurate than inventing a path. Walltime is a real reader not in the brief's list; include it.

rejected.option: Claim the site generator reads records/
rejected.why: Not supported by the code read.

decisions.choice: Make job 7 (cutover) own the reader moves, or add the work as a new job 6a placed before job 7 so readers read the branch before records/ is frozen. Pick: readers switch in job 7 behind a single reader seam, with `records/` still on main until job 8.
decisions.reason: The brief says 'cutover after build job 6' and 'two weeks between job 7 and job 8'. Keeping job numbering stable keeps those open-point values meaningful. Job 7 is already sized as a switch; the two seams make the change small. If the producer judges it too big, state a split inside job 7 without renumbering.

rejected.option: Insert a new job and renumber
rejected.why: Changes the meaning of 'after job 6', 'between job 7 and 8' and breaks references in D112 and §11.

rejected.option: Do the reader moves in job 8
rejected.why: Records would be unread while main no longer holds them.

decisions.choice: State the cutover as: C0 is chosen after job 6 passes, and job 7 is the cutover job; the pending window is 15 minutes as a fixed value; two weeks between jobs 7 and 8.
decisions.reason: These are Sri's decided values under the addenda.

decisions.choice: Pre-merge up-to-date requirement is added to §5.1 step 1 and to the host-rules requirement list. If the host does not require it, the squash's parent can differ from the head's base, so the status verified a different base than the merge used; consequence: the squash rule of §6 cannot be proved from the status, so the landing is treated as pending and then fails as unattributed, unless Athena re-verifies after merge or the user declares an intervention.
decisions.reason: Criterion 4 asks what happens without it. Name one consequence and one recovery.

rejected.option: Silently assume the host requires it

files.purpose: Branch rename throughout, why-a-branch text, host-rules requirement, up-to-date requirement, readers section, build plan update, filled open points, accepted status.
D112: status accepted citing the 2026-10-23 addenda; branch name in Decision, Tradeoff and Provenance; remove 'proposed' and 'not accepted'; add readers, pre-merge and decided values.
Update the D112 entry that says awaiting Sri's decision and record the acceptance and three changes.

steps: Read BRIEF.md addenda of 2026-10-23 only to confirm they exist; do not edit it. Check xtask/tests for tests that parse docs/decisions.md.

In records-history.md: set Status to accepted citing the addenda; rename every `refs/athena/records` and `refs/athena/*` to the branch `athena/records` with its own root; keep one sentence explaining the change from the earlier custom ref.

Rewrite the A4 row so a plain clone carries the branch; rewrite the §3 recommendation; replace the host-accepts-refs assumption with a host-rules requirement (forbid force-push and deletion on athena/records; require branches up to date before merge).
Add to §5.1 the dependence of the pre-merge status on up-to-date branches, so the squash's parent equals the head's base, and the consequence if the host does not require it.
State 15 minutes as the value in §5.2; state C0 is picked after job 6 in §4 and §10; state two weeks between job 7 and job 8 in §4, §10 and §11.

Add the readers section (after §8 or §9) with a table: reader, reads now (file and function), reads after (the Records::load treeish becomes the branch tip; read_records root becomes a worktree of athena/records at a fixed path in the state directory), owning job. Rows: status (status.rs Records::load), forecasting and reference forecaster (scoring.rs history/reference), scoring (athena-score score_records fed by Records), retry carry (reading.rs carry), audit (auditor.rs), introspection (introspect.rs read_records), study site generator (xtask/src/site.rs reads studies/, not records/; no move), plus walltime (xtask/src/walltime.rs) and the grouped Records::load callers.

Update §10 so job 7 includes moving the readers (and the worktree setup), and job 1 no longer checks host acceptance of the ref; fix §7 and §6.1 text; empty §12 of the three filled points and the refs/athena/* point, leaving what remains.

In decisions.md D112: set status wording to accepted citing the addenda, use `athena/records` in Decision, Tradeoff and Provenance, remove 'proposed' and 'not accepted', add the host-rules and up-to-date dependency to Tradeoff.
In CHANGELOG.md: change the existing Unreleased entry (remove 'Awaiting Sri's decision', 'proposed') and add an entry for the acceptance and three changes.
Grep for `refs/athena`, 'proposed', 'not accepted', 'example'; run git status, git diff --stat, cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy, cargo test --locked.
